steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Thank you for coming.
It just happens I'm on duty today...
Taihe, what is there that we cannot discuss in the Department of Discipline and Supervision's offices?
So it is about Deputy Minister Yu after all.
Are you truly so eager to deal with your predecessor, Deputy Minister Lin Qingyan?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: This, too, is the Department of Discipline and Supervision Censorate's responsibility. Perhaps you are being too negligent with this matter, Monitor Censor Jie Zhen.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: This is precisely why I summoned you two here.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The Department of Discipline and Supervision monitors a variety of officials among its ranks. Though the man in question has since resigned and returned to his home, he must be held liable for the transgressions he committed during his tenure.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: This has much to do with Deputy Minister Yu Cheng's fabrication of evidence during the impeachment of Langyi's magistrate all those years ago, and though you two have already discussed this matter for many times, we have yet to reach a conclusion.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: In roughly two hours, Deputy Minister Yu Cheng will arrive in this place...

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: You summoned him here behind my back?!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Such is Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: We can ill afford to wait any longer. Regardless of how this is resolved, the two of you must arrive at a conclusion in these two scant hours.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If he will be brought to justice, then we three shall hear this case here in the courts' stead to uphold the law of Great Yan.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If we instead turn a blind eye, then I ask you to keep your distance when Deputy Minister Yu arrives and let us catch up on old times.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: These hills are less than twenty li from the capital. The moment he enters the city, there will be no more room to turn the situation around.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: As I've always said, you truly are unreasonable.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I've said this many times as well. Deputy Minister Lin Qingyan merely does what the Deputy Minister of the Central Judicial Office Assistant must.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Ten years ago, when Deputy Minister Yu inspected the nation's many prisons, he passed by Langyi and indicted the local magistrate. After a year and three months, the magistrate died in prison.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: And I discovered certain discrepancies while going over the literature.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Three months ago, I visited Langyi and looked into the matter... The key evidence that Deputy Minister Yu used during the impeachment, such as the account book and directory of personnel were all indeed fabricated.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The evidence I have gathered is conclusive, irrefutable.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: I don't mean to refute this old case, no.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: I just mean to ask... Do you think the magistrate did not deserve his impeachment?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Is it not the truth that during his years in the position, he deceived the entire institution from top to bottom, appropriating great sums of the royal court's wealth?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Is it not also indisputable, nay, irrefutable that he repeatedly misused his position and issued local decrees to levy new taxes?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: How long did he block the appeals of subjects demanding redress for their injustices, bribe government inspectors and officials, falsify the sentiment of the populace in his reports to the capital, causing immeasurable harm?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Of the dozens of charges he was impeached upon, was there a single one that was fabricated?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: They were all true.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If Deputy Minister Yu had implicated a good man, we would not be discussing the matter.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The impeachment of the Langyi magistrate also implicated some dozen mandarins in the Langyi and capital governments, as well as the inspectorate. The ensuing investigations showed all were guilty as charged. The news shook the court, struck the provinces with astonishment, and improved social ethos for the better.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: From what I have heard, letters of appreciation from the masses arrived to the Central Judicial Office and the Department of Discipline and Supervision in tall piles.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: From a bystander's point of view, was the impeachment somehow not satisfactory to the citizenry?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Put another way, Deputy Minister Yu's actions were to the benefit of the masses, were they not?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Taihe, what do you think?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I agree.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Furthermore, it would seem that you have misunderstood me.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: I never said I would not handle this matter.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: By handle, you mean...?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: The Judicial Review Office will remove Yu Cheng's name from the Haoran Pavilion. The Ministry of Revenue will confiscate his retirement, and the benefits he enjoyed after returning to his hometown will be cancelled.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Furthermore, should Yu Cheng's relatives apply for official posts in the future, the court will take this into consideration.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: At the same time, all officials of the Ministry of Justice, the Department of Discipline and Supervision, and the Central Judicial Office must, regardless of their rank, take his case as a warning.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: And if Yu Cheng is truly a treacherous villain, before we send him to prison, I will first torture him with my string.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: But he dedicated his entire life to his duties. He is a good official, and he is almost seventy years of age. Can we not grant him a smooth, peaceful retirement, at the very least?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: You wish to keep this under wraps and minimize his punishment for such a major transgression... His crimes would go unpunished and hidden from all under Heaven. How is this 'the very least?'

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Taihe, what say you?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: You agree...?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Taihe, I know what kind of man you are. You always distinguish right from wrong, and you handle all official business impartially. Never have I seen you hem and haw so much. It's why you were able to become Monitor Censor so soon after you retired from the military.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: But why so hesitant this time?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You flatter me.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: To tell the truth...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Ranks and perspectives aside for the moment, I have nothing but admiration for what Deputy Minister Yu did at the time.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The magistrate was infamous for his conduct. Though Langyi saw many challenge his rule over the years, none prevailed before him.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The magistrate kept his deeds clandestine and concealed. He was a deviously cunning man, and he had just about everyone in his pocket. If he had any other choice, Deputy Minister Yu would not have resorted to such methods.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: To solve that case, he put his own personal wealth and life on the line.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Someone so honorable and upright... with such immense bravery, willing to brave even death... He is no less a man than my comrades on the battlefield.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: This is why I have no choice but to ask the two of you to make this decision.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Taihe, to be frank, I admire your gentle sentiments.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I, too, admire Deputy Minister Yu's character.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Do you see that tree ahead of us?
The three turn at the hillside corner, abruptly opening up their view.

Taihe and Jie Zhen follow Lin Qingyan's gaze. A bottomless cliff and a cloud haze block the way forward, but a lone, thin pine tree stands tall, tainting its surroundings with a jade color that cannot be hidden by the snow.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: A year ago, when I first came to the Central Judicial Office from the Tianshi Bureau, Deputy Minister Yu was my most respected predecessor.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: He wished to return home, and I insisted on seeing him off. He took a detour and brought me onto this mountain.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: No wonder you arrived much sooner than Taihe and me.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: He planted that pine tree himself many years ago.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: At the time, Deputy Minister Yu was still young and inexperienced. He climbed high and looked far ahead to see nothing but clouds and mist. Suddenly, the sunlight broke through, dispersing the gloom, shining clear on heaven and earth...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: He thought of how he was to enter the capital, to take up his post at the Central Judicial Office. He was filled with a mix of emotions.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: He vowed to uphold justice for the people, to become the last line of defense for the laws of Yan, to ensure that none would be wronged. Thus, he planted a pine sapling to symbolize his determination.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Our good Deputy Minister Yu!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Good indeed. The sapling has now grown into a tall, upright tree. Likewise, my predecessor has lived up to his aspirations from when it was planted.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Yu Cheng is the most outstanding Deputy Minister the Central Judicial Office has had. He made countless fair judgments, and the case of Langyi's magistrate is not the most difficult he has adjudicated.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: He erred only this once. But he did err this once.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: To see a pine tree mature in such a way is a rare sight.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Anyone who climbs so far to be faced with such a tree, standing tall, reaching for the clouds, enduring storm and wind unbreaking, would find his heart invigorated.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Deputy Minister Lin Qingyan, were this tree toppled, to what degree would the enthusiasm of those climbers be dampened?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: It seems Monitor Censor Jie Zhen has a point to make.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: I wish to suppress this case, not only to protect Yu Cheng.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Deputy Minister Qingyan, having just taken a post at the Central Judicial Office barely one year ago, has thoroughly examined all documents pertaining to the former Deputy Minister. Following his retirement, the former Deputy Minister was recalled and convicted.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Does this not suggest that the next Deputy Minister of the Central Judicial Office should investigate you upon his appointment?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Deputy Minister Qingyan happened to come across the relevant records during routine archival work...

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Indeed. But what difference does that make?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: You and I both know that even the purest, most innocent soul cannot withstand investigation. Particularly in matters concerning civil service.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Think about it. If we establish this precedent, officials of all rank will stand on edge, acting only out of concern over future investigation. It will hinder the execution of their duties.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: The slightest indication that one may have lost his way becomes a vulnerability. Whether colleagues or successors, one never knows when ill intention may uncover something, with imprisonment the end result.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: If we continue down this path, would anyone dare make progress during their tenure?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Deputy Minister Qingyan, the Three Organs of Justice are not the Tianshi Bureau. We have more to weigh than righteousness alone.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Jie Zhen, why do you change the subject?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: As the Deputy Minister of the Central Judicial Office, you have chosen to describe the act of forging evidence as merely 'losing one's way'?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I'm afraid I cannot agree with your position.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: You would take no action and call it an act of preservation?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: In my early years studying Lei Fa, the Tianshi instructed me: 'One who controls lighting must first respect its power, lest one come to harm oneself.'

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Among the Three Organs of Justice, the Department of Discipline and Supervision oversees the civil service, while the Central Judicial Office reviews criminal cases. Behind every official and every case, there must be a pair of watchful eyes and a final checkpoint.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: And so do we require a Censorate to censure the Censors? Another pair of eyes behind us? There is no perfect system under Heaven, and it is not possible to keep infinitely layering inspectors.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: And so the ones we must be inspecting first and foremost are ourselves. Otherwise, how are we to ensure that the law truly protects all the subjects of Great Yan?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: We all serve the Three Organs of Justice. You may not be unaware of this principle!

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Does the law not allow for compassion?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: Is it you who is truly ruthless, or is it the law of Yan?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: If those who enforce the law are not bound by the law, then what is the use of establishing the law?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Calm yourselves, please...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I must see this case through. And not only to dispose of Yu Cheng.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Back in Langyi, Deputy Minister Yu lost his way and resorted to half measures when faced with a corrupt but cunning magistrate. In pursuit of justice, this seems somewhat understandable.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Were it you or I, we may have made the same choice.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: But what if the future brought us a more ambiguous case? What if, in the future, we found ourselves with ill intent?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Would it be easier to lose our way and resort to such measures in order to seize a good man in place of a bad one?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Indeed, it would make the execution of ill intent that much simpler.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The law of the land decides life and death. In the fulfillment of our duties, we may tolerate neither error nor deviation.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Deputy Minister Qingyan speaks with enlightening wisdom.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: There is no margin of error before the law. The Grand Tutor taught me as much.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If my admiration for Deputy Minister Yu has brought shame to the laws of Yan... such would be a breach of my duty.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Now then, Deputy Minister Yu should be arriving momentarily.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Monitor Censor Jie Zhen, have you anything else to say?

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: The conversation having arrived where it has... Deputy Minister Qingyan raised the case, and so the right of adjudication naturally lies with her.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: I admit you speak with reason and logic.

steps.name: Jie Zhen
steps.text: But I still ask the both of you to consider the impact that impeaching Yu Cheng may have, particularly in comparison to the impeachment of the Langyi magistrate.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: And so, Deputy Minister, adjudicate.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What we call law is like lightning, looming over the heads and hearts of man.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: All that is, is the Thunderlight.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: If the thunder does not strike, then Lin Qingyan cannot function as Deputy Minister of the Central Judicial Office.

Under the shining sun, a sudden thunderclap startles the fowlbeasts into swift flight, and accumulated snow on the branches collapses in a flurry. Yet the pine tree remains tall and gains a few more shades of green.
At the foot of the mountain, the awaited guest steps out of his vehicle. He peers upward, unmoving for a long while.
